title: How decentralized AI networks are challenging Big Tech

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if decentralized AI networks could finally break Big Tech’s stranglehold on innovation and data?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Federated learning and blockchain-based models now let users train AI without centralized cloud dependency.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But data privacy risks persist—decentralized systems can still be exploited if not designed with transparency and consent.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are using zero-knowledge proofs and open-source frameworks to ensure user control and auditability.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where AI is a public good, developed collaboratively and governed by communities, not corporations.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future may belong to networks where power shifts from giants to the many, one algorithm at a time.

video_cue: A decentralized network of nodes glowing with data streams, evolving into a shared AI model across a global map.
